title: OpenSmash64
description:
An experimental Smash 64 browser port with 34 fighters and eight selected stages. Includes the main Remix roster plus Dark Samus, Lucas, Roy and Dr. Luigi. Choose a fighter and stage with the native controller menu. Online uses 3 stocks, 8 minutes, no items, and P1's stage choice.

Original fighters retain native moves. Imported fighters have ROM models, movement, animations and normal attacks; custom specials and character mechanics are still being ported. Imported fighters currently use default costumes. This build is not yet suitable for serious ranked competition.

Keyboard: arrows or WASD move, M selects/attacks, O goes back/special, P jumps, Q shields, Enter is Start. Gamepads and landscape touch controls are supported.
notes: Local OpenSmash64 candidate. See remix/MAIN.md for stage sources, source extraction, validation, and known port limitations. Earlier uploaded media and approval results describe an older build and must be refreshed before publishing this version.
